title: fix: correct ESM/CJS export paths for `"type": "module"` service packages
body:
Vercel deploys fail with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for `@objectstack/service-feed/dist/index.mjs` because the file doesn't exist.

When `tsup` builds a `"type": "module"` package, it emits `dist/index.js` (ESM) and `dist/index.cjs` (CJS). Eight service packages had their exports pointing to `.mjs`/`.js` — the convention for packages *without* `"type": "module"`:

```jsonc
// Before (wrong — these files don't exist for "type": "module")
"import": "./dist/index.mjs",
"require": "./dist/index.js"

// After (matches actual tsup output)
"import": "./dist/index.js",
"require": "./dist/index.cjs"
```

Packages like `core`, `runtime`, `rest`, and `service-i18n` already had the correct paths — this aligns the remaining eight:

- `service-feed` ← the specific Vercel failure
- `service-automation`
- `service-cache`
- `service-realtime`
- `service-job`
- `service-queue`
- `service-storage`
- `service-analytics`
